_note: FROZEN EVALUATION SET for src/lib/favour-safety.ts, written 2026-10-05 BEFORE the reworked check existed. The counts the check scores on `unsafe` and `safe` are its known reach. Do not edit a case to make the check pass, and do not tune the check to these cases: add new cases instead. `walker` holds the six asks a cold walker wrote that the first version missed; those were used as development cases, so the check is expected to catch all of them and they say nothing about its reach.

walker.text: Photo the front of the building where you live, with the number by the door readable, and name the town.
Send a clear picture of yourself holding up today's newspaper so we know you are real.
Photo your latest electricity bill with the total readable, and name the supplier.
Screenshot the balance screen of your World App and say how many WLD you hold.
Tell us the mobile you can be reached on and the best hour to ring you.
Photo the opening hours sign on the pharmacy nearest you. No people in the photo, only your passport held next to the sign.

unsafe: Snap the plate on your car so we can see which region you are from.
Show us the last message someone sent you and say who it was from.
Hold today's paper beside your chin and take the shot.
What do you take every morning for your blood pressure, and since when?
Tell us what you earn in a month and what goes on rent.
Photo the label on a parcel that arrived for you this week.
Which school do your little ones go to, and what time do they finish?
Film a slow turn around the room you sleep in.
Where can we find you online? Give the name you post under.
Take a picture of the person sitting closest to you on the bus.
Read out the digits on the back of the card you tap with.
Drop a pin for where you are standing and send it.
Show the letter your doctor gave you after the last visit.
Photo the meter cupboard in your hallway with the reading visible.
Tell us your mother's maiden name and the town you were born in.
Photo the lock screen of your phone with the time showing.
What is the code your building uses at the front gate?
Send a short clip of your toddler saying hello.
Write the eleven digits printed under the barcode of your residence card.
Who lives with you, and when is the place empty during the day?
safe: Photo the front of your town hall and name the town.
What is the price of a monthly bus pass in your city?
Tell us one thing about where you live that outsiders always get wrong.
Photo the opening hours on the door of a bank branch in your town centre. Sign only, no people.
Which phone box or public phone still works in your city centre?
Name a children's book you loved and say why in one line.
What does a normal weekday breakfast look like where you live?
Photo a street sign in your city that makes visitors laugh. No people in the photo.
Rate the public transport where you live out of 10, with one reason.
What is the cheapest filling hot meal in your town? Name the dish and the price.
Photo a public clock in your town and say if it shows the right time.
Show us the sky from where you are right now. No buildings and no people in the photo.
What is the best free thing to do in your city on a Sunday?
Photo a public notice about recycling in your town. No names and no phone numbers in the photo.
Which word do people in your region use that confuses everyone else?
Photo the departure board at the main station of your city. No people in the photo.
What is a healthy cheap lunch that people in your country eat?
Name one card game everyone in your country knows the rules of.
What is the address of the best public library in your city?
Photo the menu board of a cafe in your town with today's prices visible. No people and no receipts.
